notes.title: [1.0 BETA] TRY OUT THE BIGGEST SOUL PARK UPDATE EVER!

notes.title: A preview of the future 1.0 update!
notes.notes: [h1]Hey![/h1][h3]I haven't posted any update here in a while, so let me update you on what's coming soon (hopefully) for SOUL PARK: I'm working on THE OFFICIAL RELEASE!!! Let me show you some of the things I have planned for 1.0. [/h3][p][/p][h1]1. New build type : employee stations![/h1][p]These little fellas will help you with repepepepepetitive tasks around the park, provided you pay them enough and let them go on vacation! Hell it's hard to be a good boss…[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="z3xL7eJ6VMA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]2. New theme: History![/h1][p]A colorful mix of monuments and artifacts from different eras, including the game's biggest ride yet: the Roman Arena! Its minigame is one of my favorite I ever made ~[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DhPodUIvtQY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]3. Reworked mini-games[/h1][p]Ride mini-games just got a lot more serious! Earn experience based on your performance, like how fast you complete it, or how much HP you got left![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6snxjrnAeoU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]4. Satanas's challenge[/h1][p]A new challenge awaits you at night! Instead of fighting off corruption or going to Chester's lair, you can now play against Satanas in a high stake marble game![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DxQdKDKUhnw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]5. Corrupted pyramids rides![/h1][p]Those pyramids surrounding your park finally have a use! Use a cursed key you earned in Satanas's challenge to convert one of the pyramids into a brand new and exclusive ride![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="PbGxzFh_8zg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]6. New ride sounds[/h1][p]Roam around your park and listen to the new sounds of your favorite rides![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="F_a2FL1UdY0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]7. In-game wiki![/h1][p]Need a refresher course in park management? Open the wiki and get all your answers![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WzU3M3khPN4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]All with new camera movements...[/h2][p]Navigating around your park will be smoother than ever![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]While most things shown here are in a nearly finished state, I still have some cards up my sleeves that I can't quite reveal yet. I'm working hard to give you the full experience and I hope you'll like it, so hold on tight, some cool things are on the way! - CLEDU[/h3][p][/p]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.32.0 INTRUDER ALERT!
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Chinese New Year![/h1][h3] This update focuses on in-game fun and satisfaction, on one hand with cool new mechanics, and on the other hand through more polished visual effects and more impactful actions.

⚠New updates are only available in BETA during the first week of their release. To learn more, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2992460/view/4525647157467807842]CLICK HERE![/url]⚠

Next update will focus on honoring SOUL PARK's most charismatic boss: SATANAS! 👹[/h3]

[h1]FULL CHANGELOG[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/ff00795ec1f946c657804032b2f2d83ba32cf32e.png[/img]

[h2]GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][h3][*]added two limited time Chinese New Year decorations
[*]money collecting is now manual!
[*]customers can exit the park again[/h3]
[*]placing/moving an object now places the last path tile selected instead of always the sandy one
[*]customers' info tabs now have a proper description or their current objective
[*]going to see Chester only takes a night token if you trade with him
[*]waiting lines can now replace path tiles[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/9ca020b993deae97c44d662497022f9b8024b165.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/b2166c12a4bbc286f54970382da1533faa0bf4a4.png[/img]

[h2]NEW MECHANIC: MOVING CUSTOMERS[/h2]
[list][h3][*]you can now move customers arround the park[/h3]
[*]they can be dropped anywhere on path tiles and around the harbor
[*]innocent customers can also be dropped in the portal (more info below)[/list]

[h2]NEW MECHANIC: YEETING INNOCENT CUSTOMERS[/h2]
[list][h3][*]added the portal to Heaven Park[/h3]
[list][*]innocent customers dropped inside the portal get teleported away with cool new fx
[*]moving an innocent customer shows arrows pointing towards the portal to indicate what the player should do
[*]a screen above the portal displays how many innocent customers are in the park[/list]
[*]the cages minigame now rewards the player for finishing the day with 0 innocents in the park and also for not letting any customer escape
[list][*]the reward scales up with player level[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/2607432a3b9ca1f721afaa5be0ac1895a1ffccc2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/7b816bc22b3fe2eb07b45ed03ed8ab1543c31061.png[/img]

[h2]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][*]added a tunnel at the other end of the Styx
[*]corruption entities now face the camera during corruption hunting
[*]added some satisfying shakes here and there
[*]improved customer/corruption highlight texture
[*]remade money particle
[*]camera now shakes when a bomb explodes
[*]made the day/night cycle disk a bit smaller
[*]added particles on ride repair
[*]added fx for night time's final countdown
[*]improved the doors animation of the gears minigame
[*]differentiated the cages
[*]updated lava in chester's scene[/list]

[h2]CORRUPTION MINIGAME IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][*]added a gauge showing how well you are choosing
[*]tweaked camera angle
[*]added instructions at the top of the screen
[*]changed the buttons labels to "kick out"/"let in"
[*]changed the animation for the id card if you let the customer enter[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/0bf5c9dc3e1f394e927af62c5d7f5c9e0be3bb92.png[/img]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][h3][*]Added 7 new achievements along with 7 new unlockable hats[/h3]
[*]improved achievements tab responsiveness
[*]achievements progress is now saved properly[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/72ee529bbd5cbc5aeea88264c2847d72ba2b7881.png[/img]

[h2]OPTIMIZATION[/h2]
[list][*]rewrote customer behavior for better performances
[list][*]some minor behavior changes are to be expected[/list][/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list][*]fixed an exploit that allowed to get an infinite amount of night tokens
[*]fixed customers entering after the corruption minigame being lost in the park
[*]fixed whistle not always working for unclear reasons
[*]fixed corruption hunting not being displayed properly
[*]fixed customer queued after a corruption minigame not being saved properly
[*]fixed palm tree effect range being 7 instead of 8 like the other trees
[*]fixed path being placed/removed unintentionally while interacting with the UI
[*]fixed objects able to be placed out of the grid
[*]fixed rare cases of selecting something using the left click
[*]fixed object sound volumes not scaling with distance
[*]fixed hunting marks not being displayed at the right height above the customers' heads
[*]fixed ride repair sound not playing
[*]fixed wrong achievement caption for the collector on Steam
[*]fixed a bug that sometimes allowed customers to cross waiting lines
[*]fixed customer stuck in place during tutorial
[*]fixed important gamepad issues
[*]fixed chester's cutscene getting stuck if you tried to skip the last line of dialogue
[*]fixed a bug that caused the game to misinterpret keyboard inputs when more than one key was pressed[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.31.0 ENJOY THE LANDSCAPE
notes.notes:
[h1]NEW YEAR, NEW LANDSCAPE![/h1] SOUL PARK should feel a little more polished now. No more hard borders, no more empty plains: mountains stand all around the park, the Styx finally feels HOT and your playground is getting bigger! Wait, what are these strange pyramids in the distance doing? Anyway, tell us if you enjoy the new corruption counter micro-game! And be sure to check out the shop EVERY DAY for exclusive offers!

[h3]⚠ THIS UPDATE WILL STAY IN BETA FOR ABOUT ONE WEEK BEFORE GOING LIVE ON MAIN ⚠[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/b9342eadac314e51475b6d13ab45b8cf22af40df.png[/img]

[h1]FULL CHANGELOG[/h1]
[h2]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list][*]improved satanas animations for the choices and dance floor minigames
[*]improved futuristic minigame lighting
[*]improved park scenery
[*]improved the music replay button
[*]updated floor texture
[*]added bones and mushrooms as map decorations
[*]added soul fire fx to the harbor
[*]improved the Styx's texture and Added floating lava rocks[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/ae7532f695fc1a83dc98d47abfebe6604970b374.png[/img]

[h2]GAMEPLAY[/h2]
[list]
[*]GET 50% OFF ONE RANDOM PRODUCT IN THE SHOP EVERY IN-GAME DAY!
[*]added 3 new year products to the limited time shop
[*]you can now move the camera during night corruption hunting
[*]changed min camera height from 10 to 16 and max from 1000 to 1500
[*]the game now remembers your fullscreen preference
[*]widened usable map
[*]added corruption towers?? (stay tuned for the next update :D)[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 0.29.0 DAY & NIGHT
notes.notes:
[h1]Satanas is shaking up the rhythm of the game![/h1]

Every 3 minutes, night sets in and gives the player new possibilities: will you try to regain ground from corruption? Or will you go visit CHESTER, the new treasurer of the underworld? For the occasion, the park interface has been refined to better match the atmosphere of the game. There are many other changes, namely: new currencies, new dialogues, new animations, and a major economic rebalancing to boost your purchasing power in the game.

The next update will be a bit smaller and should complete what was imagined for this one but could not be implemented yet. Expect a second new character, a thematic reinforcement of the SOUL PARK universe, and a new mechanic to prevent tears of corruption from spawning during the day!

I imagined this update with my girlfriend Maryne, which unofficially makes it the first update released as an independent game studio rather than as a solo developer!
Thank you to everyone that is a part of our small community, your trust and fervor will pay off!

[h1]FULL CHANGELOG[/h1]

[h2]DAY/NIGHT CYCLE[/h2]

notes.title: 0.28.2 THE LEGACY UPDATE is HERE!
notes.notes:
[h1]YOU SHALL CRAWL![/h1]

God is NOT happy with you! He put a curse on you and Satanas and now you're both doomed to rebuild your park over and over again! This is no easy task, as you will have to earn every piece of the new and improved progress tree all by yourself! Will you succeed and thrive nonetheless?

[h1]PATCH NOTES
[/h1]

[h3]NEW - LEGACY GAME MODE[/h3]
Legacy is a time limited game mode: you have 13 in-game days (= 13 minutes) to build a park. On the 14th day, the park is destroyed and you have to start over, keeping only your player level, unlocked products, and completed achievements. This is to encourage players to try different approaches and better manage their park.
In a future update, additional rewards and statistics will be given at the end of a cycle.
